placements.why: All three facts are concrete instances of this leaf's theme — the product capturing decisions at the moment of consensus. The shipped async decision widget IS the capture mechanism; the Zephyr integration extends that capture across Slack/Teams/Discord without added steps; and the 23-point velocity is the measured proof-point Tina attributes directly to that capture mechanism working. None of these is itself a recurring subject — they are evidence feeding the already-established 'captures the decision at the moment' theme, which this document's Sprint 4 retro re-affirms rather than extends. Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate were considered but describe the positioning frame and the upstream problem respectively, not the capture mechanism these three segments actually describe.
